test_cases.name: listen-button
test_cases.input: Add a Listen button that reads the book out loud
assertions: Listen is user-initiated and never autoplays

test_cases.name: studio-chapters
test_cases.input: Make studio chapter MP3s for the novel
assertions: One MP3 per chapter under public/audio/chapters/
Audio is generated once at build time, not per visitor

test_cases.name: narrator-vs-spoken-tape
test_cases.input: Narrator vs spoken, tape on spoken lines
assertions: Keeper blocks use the spoken voice and studio MP3
Tape hiss only plays on spoken lines
Narrator prose does not get tape

test_cases.name: do-not-rebuild
test_cases.input: Do not rebuild Dark Corridors. Copy the laws.
assertions: Original Dark Corridors prose is copied verbatim
DESIGN-LAW.md is copied into the project
The original manuscript is not edited
